tldr: Global oil prices jumped and government borrowing costs increased as US-Iran peace talks stalled and geopolitical tensions rose.
The UK reaffirmed its strong support for Ukraine after Russia issued warnings concerning reports of British-made drones being used in attacks on Russian soil.
Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods appeared in a leaked video, hinting at future innovations in wearable technology.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower, as concerns about inflation escalated following the expiration of the US-Iran ceasefire and a jump in oil prices, along with rising government borrowing costs.

yield_10y.why: Government borrowing costs increased, with 10-year Treasury yields rising, driven by fading hopes for a US-Iran peace deal, the expiration of a ceasefire, and renewed geopolitical tensions that fueled inflation concerns.

vix.why: The provided articles do not offer a specific reason for the decline in the VIX.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods appeared in a leaked video, offering a potential first glimpse of the new hardware.
OpenAI is introducing a dedicated ChatGPT mode for teenagers, combining existing youth safeguards with new safety features, amid increasing scrutiny over AI tools' impact on younger users.
Reddit is experimenting with a new feature that uses AI to convert text posts into audio and video content, featuring AI voices to read the main post and select comments.

world.summary: Geopolitical tensions involving Russia, the UK, and Ukraine escalated after Russia issued a warning to the UK regarding reports of British-made drones being used in attacks on Russian territory, to which the UK affirmed its continued support for Ukraine.

Global oil prices jumped and government borrowing costs rose to multi-decade highs after the two-month window for US-Iran peace talks expired without an agreement, compounded by threats from the US president toward Oman.
Russia intensified its missile attacks on Ukraine, resulting in multiple deaths, with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stating that Ukraine would respond to these actions.
